exposure: standard care (self-monitoring of blood glucose [SMBG] alone)
outcome: Glycemic control (HbA1c, time in range [TIR], time below range [TBR], time above range [TAR])
cohort: 300 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, 132 using isCGM and 168 using SMBG
finding: While isCGM use initially improved glycemic control in the second trimester, this effect was not sustained, and offspring of isCGM users were more likely to experience neonatal hypoglycemia.
